$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBX (AIP France, chart dated 2026-07-09): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Périgueux-Bassillac

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: Possible IFR operations.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of RWY prohibited.
TORA, ASDA and LDA RWY 29 reduced due to RESA.
Unpaved RWY reserved for home-based ACFT and authorized gliders pilots.
During ATS SKED, fees are payable at the TWR.
Convex runway: from BRAVO holding point, THR 29 is invisible.
When strong crosswind, light to severe turbulence THR 11 and 29.
Due to reliefs, the airfield is in darkness at SS+15 MIN.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Preferred QFU: 112° due to noise pollution.
TKOF from TWY A: only permitted during the day and on RWY 11.
TKOF from TWY B: prohibited day and night, RWY backtrack is mandatory.
North circuit available only for authorized home based aircraft using the unpaved runway.
The commercial apron in front of the TWR must remain cleared.
Overhead AD arrival at 1800 ft AMSL for all ACFT before entering the traffic circuit.
Low altitude circuit at 500 ft MNM with instructor on board.
TWY and apron strength: 26 F/C/W/T.
TKOF on paved RWY29: by night, due to curved funnel, overhead end of RWY take 242°.
VFR MTOW < 1.9 t: PPR 48HR.
IFR and VFR MTOW > 1.9 t: PPR 48HR and ATS presence mandatory and handling assistance mandatory request on portal MyHandling (https://cy.myhandlingsoftware.com).
FBO EDEIS: perigueux.afis@edeis.com PCL: PPR 48HR, instructions provided by AD operator during the request.
Activité IFR possible.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.

TORA, ASDA et LDA RWY 29 réduites cause RESA.
RWY non revêtue réservée aux ACFT basés et aux pilotes de planeurs autorisés.
En HOR ATS, les redevances sont payables à la tour.
Piste bombée : du point d'attente BRAVO, le THR 29 est invisible.
Par fort vent de travers, turbulences modérées à fortes aux seuils 11 et 29.
Cause relief, le terrain se trouve dans la pénombre à CS+15 MIN.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
QFU 112° préférentiel cause nuisances.
Décollage depuis TWY A : autorisé uniquement de jour et en piste 11.
Décollage depuis TWY B : interdit jour et nuit, remontée de piste obligatoire.
Le parking commercial au pied de la TWR doit rester libre.
Arrivée verticale AD à 1800 ft AMSL pour tout aéronef avant intégration dans le circuit de piste.
Circuit basse hauteur à 500 ft MNM possible avec instructeur à bord.
Résistance TWY et PRKG : 26 F/C/W/T.
Décollage piste 29 revêtue : de nuit, en raison de la trouée courbe, passant l'extrémité de piste, prendre 242°.
Vols VFR MTOW < 1.9 t : PPR 48HR.
